Line F. Total number of employees in the M E A

widgets.widgetName: Name(s) as shown on your California tax return
Qualified taxpayer 's S I C code. See instructions (4 digits)
California Secretary of State (S O S) file number (12 digits)
Part I, Line 1a. Hiring credit carryover from Schedule Z, line 6A, column (f) or line 7, column (c)
Line 1b. Credit amount to be elected as refundable in future years. See instructions

Part II, Line 2. Enter the average apportionment percentage of your business that is in the former M E A from Worksheet I, Section A, line 4. If your operation is entirely within one former M E A, the average apportionment percentage is 100% (1.00)

Schedule Z, Part I, Line 1. Trade or business income. Individuals: Enter the amount from Worksheet I, Section B, line 14, column (c) on this line and on line 3 (skip line 2). See instructions. Corporations which file a combined report, enter the taxpayer's business income apportioned to California (see form F T B 3808, Part II instructions)
Line 2. Corporations: Enter the average apportionment percentage from Worksheet I, Section A, line 4. See instructions
Line 3. Multiply line 1 by line 2
Line 4a. Compute the amount of tax due using the amount on line 3. See instructions

Line 4b. Enter the amount of tax from Form 540, line 35; Form 540NR, line 42; Form 541, line 21; Form 100, line 23; Form 100W, line 23; Form 100S, line 21; or Form 109, line 10. Corporations and S corporations, see instructions
Line 5. Enter the smaller of line 4a or line 4b. This is the limitation based on the M E A business income. Go to Part II, Part III, or Part IV. See instructions
Part II, Line 6. Hiring credit carryover, A, (e) Limitation based on M E A business income
Line 6. Hiring credit carryover, A, (f) Credit carryover used on schedule P can never be greater than column (d) or column (e)
Line 6. Hiring credit carryover, B, (b) Total prior year carryover
Line 6. Hiring credit carryover, B, (c) Total credit assigned from form F T B 3544, Part A, column (g)
Line 6. Hiring credit carryover, B, (d) Total credit column (b) minus column (c)
Line 6. Hiring credit carryover, B, (e) Limitation based on M E A business income
Line 6. Hiring credit carryover, B, (g) Total credit carryover column (d) minus column (e)

Line 7. Hiring credit carryover, (c) Credit carryover used this year by S corporation
Line 7. Hiring credit carryover, (d) Carryover column (b) minus column (c)

Line 8. Hiring credit carryover, (c) Total credit assigned from form F T B 3544, Part A, column (g)
